findings.suggestion: Add an end event to properly terminate the process.

findings.message: Element "sub" (subProcess) has no outgoing sequence flows.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to a downstream element or an end event.

findings.message: Element "orphan" (task) is not reachable from any start event.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to the process flow or remove it.

findings.message: Element "orphan" (task) has no outgoing sequence flows.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to a downstream element or an end event.

findings.message: Sub-process "Sub" has no error boundary event.
findings.suggestion: Add an error boundary event to catch unhandled errors thrown inside the sub-process.

findings.message: Start event "S" has no documentation describing expected input variables.
findings.suggestion: Add documentation listing the process input variables so callers know the expected contract.
